followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: Your follow-up is part of the same conversation thread, so I'm keeping it on the model already handling it for continuity. To explain my prior choice: your request was a structured, well-specified identification task (name three aspects of a specific artwork) with clear completion criteria. Both models score essentially the same on extraction/retrieval evals (within run-to-run variance), so I broke the tie using self-reported task preference — Plover specifically prefers well-specified retrieval and identification tasks, while Avocet showed no stable preference along that dimension. Note that this preference is dissociated from measured quality, so it's a soft tiebreaker, not a capability claim.
